serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie_Outside.animate(MoveToRight)
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Are you alright, Annalie?
Lady Annalie: …
Lady Annalie: Yeah, I’m alright.
Bot: Why didn’t you say anything back! She’s your nemesis, right?!
Lady Annalie: There’s no good comeback to the truth.
Bot: Don’t say that, accidents happen! It’s a medical emergency!
Bot: Your model is healthy, remember? It’s just a little snag, nothing more! Don’t let the Britannia person get into your head!
#Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Y-You are right! Everything’s fine! I still have my models and all my pieces for the show are almost finished.
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Lady Annalie: That stupid ******* ***** ******* ****** Britannia just took me by surprise like the coward she is! I will utterly destroy her! {{wi}}****!
#bot.Expression.clear
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Unknown woman: Um, excuse me. We are here with little children. Could we ask you to use fewer profanities?
Lady Annalie: S-Sure, sorry about that…
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
#bot.Expression.happy
Lady Annalie: I guess it’s just one of those days… {{wi}}Things just keep piling up. 
You: It never rains but it pours…
Lady Annalie: Seriously. Let’s call it quits for today. I can feel a headache coming.
